column1: # Strong's equivalence table — Strong's numbers that name the same word.
# (variant -> canonical) pairs of Strong's numbers for the same Hebrew word: suppletive stems (yalak / halak), qere / ketiv variants of the divine name, spelling
# doublets. They are lexical facts (public-domain Strong's numbering). spine/common.py applies them when the spine is built. The list was first compiled while comparing
# the UHB tagging with another Strong's tagging; that comparison (spine/reconcile.py and its report) was removed on 2026-10-10 and nothing here is read from it.
# A lexicon spot-check of each pair is still advisable.
